Package hadur2.core.melee

Class VirtualBullet

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.melee.VirtualBullet
public final class VirtualBullet extends Object
One of the aims an opponent's recorded shot may have taken (MMOVE-3): a bullet from the shot's source along heading, flying at the shot's speed from its fire tick.
